title: Scope of supply
body_md:
The source lists nine items:

| No. | Item |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Pro-finder |
| 2 | Antenna |
| 3 | Gel connector |
| 4 | Fastening screws |
| 5 | Fuse holder |
| 6 | Flat fuse (3 A) |
| 7 | Quick guide |
| 8 | Connection cable to the alarm system |
| 9 | Connection cable |

The source does not state quantities.
source_region: Page “Scope of supply”, numbered list below the product photo
prev_context: The intended use ends on the previous page.
next_context: Chapter 1 begins with the choice of installation location.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 6: all nine items match in number and meaning, including the 3 A fuse rating. Column headers were added because the source list has none. The cable name is given without the product name while DSC-036 is open.
